name: XCC_BC_REPROCESS_DATASETS_GT
description: The table contains a record for each budgetary control validation request to reprocess transactions that failed budgetary control validations previously. Each record includes potentially different parameter values submitted in repeated requests.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for smaller group of budgetary control transaction to be processed by a particular budgetary control request.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for ledger associated with transaction.

columns.name: REPROCESS_DATA_SET
columns.description: Budgetary control transaction or group of transactions processed in each ESS request.
